about_the_game:
HUSHRUN is an atmospheric survival horror in PSX style where players find themselves in an abandoned ghost town, trying to make it through the night while avoiding terrifying zombies. Every round is a tense battle of wit, stealth, and survival instincts.

🎮 Gameplay

Local youth turned this ghost town into a deadly playground: a competition to see who can last until dawn.

  • As a human, you must explore dark streets, deserted houses, and abandoned stores, searching for safe hiding spots and avoiding lurking zombies.

  • As a zombie, your goal is the opposite — hunt down the survivors and infect them all before sunrise.

🧟 Goals

  • As a human — survive until dawn.

  • As a zombie — infect every player and claim the town.

🌟 Key Features

  • PSX-style graphics that capture the eerie charm of late-90s horror games.

  • Atmospheric ghost town filled with abandoned streets, stores, and buildings frozen in time.

  • Unique in-game chat system — pull out your smartphone to text other players, but beware: zombies can’t use it.

  • Two roles, two perspectives — hide and survive, or hunt and spread the infection.

🕹 What Awaits You

  • Survival on dark, haunted streets.

  • A tense horror atmosphere where every noise could mean danger.

  • A deadly game of hide-and-seek where every decision counts.
